description: This PHP file defines the ClaimRequestActionAPI class, which handles API requests related to performing actions (such as submit, approve, reject, pay, cancel) on claim requests within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It includes methods for updating claim request statuses, validation rules, and access control logic.

classes.name: ClaimRequestActionAPI
classes.description: API class for handling actions (e.g., submit, approve, reject) on claim requests, including status updates and validation.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles the API request to perform an action (submit, approve, reject, pay, cancel) on a specific claim request, including transaction management, permission checks, status updates, and persistence.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the 'update' method, ensuring request parameters are valid.

methods.name: getResultingState
methods.description: Determines the resulting claim request state after performing the specified action, based on user permissions and workflow rules.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Not implemented; would retrieve a single claim request but currently throws an exception.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Not implemented; would delete a claim request but currently throws an exception.
